approved.en: President De la Espriella is confronting multiple security crises as armed violence rises and a police academy attack killed 21 people, while protests over tax plans and spending cuts sweep the country. He ordered a tenth bombing against a narcoterrorist target in Valle del Cauca and called on the United States to prosecute former President Petro. U.S. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth arrived in Bogotá, delivered a C-130, met De la Espriella, and announced a US-Venezuela military partnership, but Colombia rejected a U.S. proposal for joint anti-drug strikes. The conflict recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Ecuadorian footballer Jhon Perlaza received an eight-year ban after throwing a stone at an assistant referee, illustrating violence spilling into sport. Fishermen from Ecuador have filed lawsuits against the United States, alleging a drone strike sank their boat near the Galápagos, linking the attack to broader security concerns. The bodies of Ecuadorian construction workers killed in a New York building collapse are being returned to Quito, prompting demands for justice. The UCDP counted two battle-related deaths in 2019, according to UCDP.

Kroppene til ecuadoriske bygningsarbeidere som ble drept i en bygningkollaps i New York blir returnert til Quito, noe som fører til krav om rettferdighet.
